description: Stations de Gaz naturel pour véhicules (GNV) publiques en Pays de la Loire is a dataset listed in Open Data Région Pays de la Loire, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by France Mobilité Biogaz. Ce jeu de données présente les stations GNV ouvertes au public et en projet en France avec leurs caractéristiques (année d'ouverture, exploitant, localisation, pompes GNC et/ou GNL, modes de paiements... etc.). Coverage: Pays de la Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are Tableau de Bord Régional, LOM, TEO. The portal shows 30 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2023-06-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-paysdelaloire-fr-portal.
